html.body: Date: 2025-04-14 REMARKSBy the present amendment, claims 1, 3, and 7 have been amended; claims 1-4 and 6-7 are pending.Rejection Under 35 U.S.C. 112 The amendments correct minor 112 deficiencies; no new matter has been added and no new issues have been raised. Withdrawal of the rejection is respectfully requested along with entry of the amendment.Conclusion In view of the above amendments and remarks, it is respectfully submitted that all of the claims now pending in the subject patent application are in condition for allowance; early and favorable action is respectfully requested. The Examiner is requested to contact the undersigned (e-mail is preferred due to time zone differences between U.S. and Taiwan) if she can assist in any way in expediting issuance of a patent.Respectfully submitted, Date: April 10, 2025 By: /Margaret Burke/ Margaret Burke Reg.
